Name: Intune PC inventory
Description: Lists Intune managed devices (Windows by default) with serial number, model, primary user, enrollment date, Entra registration date, last sync and compliance. Read-only. Intune has no purchase date: the Entra registration and enrollment dates are the closest match, and they reset when a device is re-joined or re-enrolled.

Parameters.Name: IncludeAllPlatforms
Parameters.Label: All platforms
Parameters.HelpText: Include iOS, Android and macOS devices as well as Windows
